name: railyard-mcp
description: Read and write access to your Railyard datacenter projects and organisations, authenticated with a personal access token.
long_description: A Model Context Protocol server that gives Codex, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, or another MCP client read and write access to your Railyard projects and organisations. It connects to hosted Railyard by default, supports self-hosted deployments through an optional base URL, and authenticates with a personal access token (PAT) minted in Railyard under User settings → Personal access tokens. Tools cover revision-safe project updates, design validation and export, shared device catalogues and roles, organisations, members and invitations, and billing state.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Return the user the personal access token authenticates as (id, email, name).

tools.name: server_info
tools.description: Report the Railyard server's version, schema version and which features are configured.

tools.name: list_orgs
tools.description: List the organisations the token's user belongs to, with role, plan and billing status.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List projects in an organisation (id, name, slug, last-updated time).

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Fetch a project's full JSON document and revision ETag by id or URL slug.

tools.name: check_project_name
tools.description: Check whether a project name is free in an org and see the slug it would get.

tools.name: list_export_formats
tools.description: List the export targets this build supports (nautobot-csv, netbox-csv, designbuilder-yaml, json).

tools.name: validate_project
tools.description: Run Railyard's design validation over a saved or inline project and return the problems it finds.

tools.name: export_project
tools.description: Export a project into a downstream format and return the generated files, unresolved placements and warnings.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new, empty project and save it to the organisation.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Conditionally save changes via a full-document PUT. Destructive; merges partial fields by default.

tools.name: rename_project
tools.description: Rename a project, updating its display name and URL slug together.

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description: Permanently delete a project and its estate. Destructive; no undo.

tools.name: move_project
tools.description: Move a project into another organisation you can write to, optionally renaming it.

tools.name: create_org
tools.description: Create a new shared organisation; the token's user becomes its owner.

tools.name: rename_org
tools.description: Change an organisation's display name (owner-only).

tools.name: delete_org
tools.description: Permanently delete a shared org and every project in it. Destructive; owner-only.

tools.name: get_org_catalog
tools.description: Read an organisation's shared device-type library and revision ETag.

tools.name: set_org_catalog
tools.description: Conditionally replace an organisation's shared device-type library wholesale. Destructive.

tools.name: get_org_roles
tools.description: Read an organisation's shared device-role vocabulary and revision ETag.

tools.name: set_org_roles
tools.description: Conditionally replace an organisation's shared device-role vocabulary wholesale. Destructive.

tools.name: list_members
tools.description: List an organisation's members — user id, email, role and joined-at.

tools.name: set_member_role
tools.description: Change an existing member's role (owner-only).

tools.name: remove_member
tools.description: Remove a member from an organisation. Destructive; owner-only.

tools.name: list_invites
tools.description: List an organisation's pending invitations (owner-only).

tools.name: invite_member
tools.description: Invite an email to join an organisation at a role (Team/Enterprise plan required).

tools.name: revoke_invite
tools.description: Withdraw a pending invitation (owner-only).

tools.name: list_my_invites
tools.description: List invitations addressed to the token user's own email.

tools.name: accept_invite
tools.description: Accept an invitation addressed to the token user's email, joining that organisation.

tools.name: get_billing
tools.description: Read an organisation's plan, status, seats and edit-entitlement.

tools.name: billing_manage_url
tools.description: Mint a Stripe Checkout or Customer Portal URL for the owner to open in a browser.

token.title: Personal access token
token.description: Your Railyard ry_… personal access token. Mint one in Railyard under User settings → Personal access tokens; it is shown only once.

base_url.title: Railyard base URL
base_url.description: Base URL of your Railyard backend. Use https://railyard.sh for the hosted service, or your self-hosted URL such as http://localhost:8080.

org.title: Default organisation (optional)
org.description: Org id, slug or name to target by default when a tool call does not name one. Leave blank to use your first (personal) organisation.
